name: Edwards Lifesciences
outlook:
What Edwards Lifesciences says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: total sales and adjusted EPSFor the fourth quarter of 2026, the company projects total sales to be between $1.67 and $1.75 billion and adjusted EPS of $0.61 to $0.69.
  • Full year 2026: sales growth and TAVR guidanceAs a result of the company’s strong third quarter results, Edwards is increasing its full-year 2026 sales growth rate guidance to approximately 11.5% from 10% to 11% and TAVR product group sales growth guidance to 9% to 9.5% from 8% to 9%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
